8 Days / 7 Nights

Spiti : Winter 4X4 Expedition

Shimla — Kinnaur — Chitkul — Gue — Dhankar Monastery — Hikkim — Komic — Langza — Kibber — Key Monastery — Chicham Bridge — Kalpa

About This Trip

Embark on an exhilarating 8-day winter expedition across the snow-draped landscapes of Spiti Valley in a 4x4 vehicle. Beginning with an overnight drive from Delhi to Shimla, the journey traverses through Kinnaur and Sangla Valley to Chitkul, the last village near the Indo-Tibetan border. Experience the frozen wonders of Spiti, including ancient monasteries at Gue, Tabo, and Dhankar, and explore iconic high-altitude villages like Hikkim, Komic, Langza, and Kibber. Cross the breathtaking Chicham Bridge and visit the iconic Key Monastery before returning via Kalpa with views of the majestic Kinner Kailash peak.

Itinerary

Overnight travel / transit to Shimla.

Drive through Sangla valley to Chitkul.

En route visit Nako village and Gue Monastery.

Exploration of Tabo and Dhankar Monasteries en route to Kaza.

Visit Hikkim, Komic, Langza, Kibber, Key Monastery, and Chicham Bridge.

Scenic drive returning towards Kinnaur valley with views of Kinner Kailash.

Drive back to Shimla from Kalpa.

Return back to Delhi in the morning.
